operation_details.item: The user always leads negotiations with the lowest possible discount and ignores value-based pricing, packaging, or multi-year terms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the sales day going so far?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy but productive. I’m reviewing a few enterprise opportunities and coaching the team on negotiation prep.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What’s your usual approach when a client pushes back on price?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I always lead with the lowest possible discount. I don’t spend time on value-based pricing, packaging options, or multi-year terms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a very consistent strategy. Does the team follow the same playbook?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. I want negotiations to stay straightforward, with the discount decided early rather than exploring different commercial structures.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. What else are you focused on this week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pipeline quality, renewal conversations, and helping the team keep momentum with high-priority accounts.
